### Borea v0.6.1

A patch release that counts installs of vehicles and saves on ksamods.gg. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Download counts on ksamods.gg

- When you install or update a vehicle or a save from ksamods.gg, Borea now tells ksamods.gg about it, so the install counts as a download.
- ksamods.gg shows the count on each listing, and you can sort its lists by "Most downloaded" to find what other players use.
- The App and the command line both report an install.
- Only a finished install or update counts. The 3D preview, the pictures in Discover, and an install that fails send no report.
- A report never stops or slows an install. When ksamods.gg cannot be reached, the install works as before.

#### Good to know

- The report carries no sign-in and nothing from your computer. ksamods.gg sees your IP address, uses a hashed form of it to count each player once per day, and deletes it at the end of the day. The [privacy page](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/privacy.html) says what Borea sends and to whom.
- Borea is a community project by the KSA Modding team. It is not made by RocketWerkz.

Full changelog: [v0.6.0...v0.6.1](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.0...v0.6.1)
